proposed.explanation: Your question asks about CIB's net profit growth in 2025, but every piece of evidence provided in this report relates to COMI (your current holding), not CIB. No CIB financial statements, EPS, share price, or any other CIB data are included in the evidence set. Without CIB's 2024 and 2025 net profit figures I cannot calculate a growth rate, and without a CIB share price I cannot size a position. I therefore cannot confirm whether CIB's profit grew by more than 30 % or make a buy recommendation. If you intended to ask about COMI instead, please note that COMI's FY2025 net-profit figure is marked AMBIGUOUS (digits hidden by a fold in the scanned page), so even for COMI the 2025-vs-2024 growth calculation would be unreliable. Please provide CIB's financial data (or clarify if you meant COMI) and I will reassess.
